lines.say: Welcome to Class 14. Getting Around: Directions and Public Transport.
Rule one. Use the base verb to give directions: go, turn, cross, take.

show.text: Use the base verb to give directions: go, turn, cross, take.
show.bn: পথনির্দেশ দিতে ক্রিয়ার মূল রূপ ব্যবহার করুন: go, turn, cross, take।

lines.say: Rule two. Use prepositions: next to, opposite, between, behind, in front of, on the corner.

show.text: Use prepositions: next to, opposite, between, behind, in front of, on the corner.
show.bn: নিয়ম ২: next to, opposite, between, behind, in front of এবং on the corner এর মতো preposition ব্যবহার করুন।

lines.say: The pharmacy is next to the bank.

show.text: The pharmacy is next to the bank.
The pharmacy is next to the bank.

lines.say: The college is opposite the hospital.

show.text: The college is opposite the hospital.
The college is opposite the hospital.

lines.say: Not: You are going straight. Say: Go straight.
The metro station is near the hostel.

show.text: The metro station is near the hostel.
The metro station is near the hostel.

lines.say: Which platform is the train to Giza?

show.text: Which platform is the train to Giza?
show.bn: গিজাগামী ট্রেনটি কোন প্ল্যাটফর্ম থেকে ছাড়ে?

show.text: Which platform is the train to Giza?
show.bn: গিজাগামী ট্রেনটি কোন প্ল্যাটফর্ম থেকে ছাড়ে?

lines.say: Sound corner. The th sound in the, this and there.

show.text: the th sound in the, this and there.
show.bn: Sound corner: the, this এবং there শব্দে th-এর ধ্বনি।

lines.say: Put your tongue between your teeth for th.
